title: Severn & Somme

This poignant collection serves as both a tribute to his comrades and an exploration of the emotional landscape of a soldier's life during wartime. Through various verses dedicated to friendship, nature, and reflections on death, Gurney encapsulates the pain and sorrow of war while celebrating the enduring connection to his homeland. The collection captures the essence of a soldier’s dual reality—fighting in the trenches while yearning for the beauty of home, evoking both the horrors of war and the solace found in nature and memory.
